observations: THIRD instance of an apparent near-duplicated opening formula in this scan's range: p32-b2 and p36-b2 both open with 'כל זה ל(ס/ג)גור לו כל הדלתות...אני ה' רופאך'. Combined with the p33/p35 duplication noted earlier, this scan flags a pattern worth dedicated editorial attention: either the 1883 exemplar itself has a printing/binding irregularity in this specific gathering (leaves 14-16, PDF pp31-38), or the Bahir's own text structure includes deliberate refrains at roughly 4-page intervals. This scan does NOT resolve which explanation is correct -- it is recorded as a Finding/candidate for the counterpart SCAN_A and/or a human reviewer to investigate, since SCAN_A's territory (PDF pp1-24) may contain the same phenomenon or a reference copy to compare against.
